summary: First-run backend test of QuantumPOS. Executed 20 pytest cases covering Phantom-style SIWS auth (challenge/verify/me including wrong-sig, tampered-msg, replay, unknown-nonce, invalid address, missing/invalid JWT), profile updates, invoice full lifecycle (create -> open-tx 34-byte verified -> confirm-open -> settle-tx 898-byte verified -> confirm-settle -> one-time-key guard), ownership isolation, 404s, check-payment with live mainnet RPC, public checkout endpoints, stats, CSV export, and config. All 20 tests passed (100%).

minor.issue: Spec says invalid address returns 400, implementation returns 401. Test tolerates either; low priority inconsistency with stated contract.

critical_code_review_comments: Potential issue: /api/invoices/{id}/confirm-open does not check current status before transitioning to 'active'. A settled invoice could be reverted to active by replaying confirm-open with a fake signature. Suggest guarding on status == 'created' (and open_tx_sig not already set).

/api/invoices/{id}/confirm-settle accepts any client-supplied signature string without any on-chain verification; the key_used flag is the only guard. Acceptable per design (Phantom-side submission), but worth noting the server trusts the client.
/api/auth/verify returns 401 for invalid address while /auth/challenge returns 400 for the same; align for consistency.

Background watcher_loop pulls up to 200 docs and sleeps 1.5s between each getBalance; with many active invoices and public mainnet RPC rate limits this could become slow. Consider batching with getMultipleAccounts.
server.py is ~540 lines and mixes auth, invoices, settlement, checkout, watcher — splitting into routers would help maintainability.
fetch_sol_usd uses CoinGecko without caching; one external call per invoice create may rate-limit at scale.
test_credentials: Dynamic Ed25519 wallets generated per test (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md)
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates throwaway merchants + invoices in MongoDB prefixed with memo 'TEST_'; no cleanup performed (invoices are per-merchant and merchants are random keypairs, so no collisions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully passing. Instruction byte-length checks (34 open / 898 settle), account metas, one-time-key guard, and WOTS signature self-verification (via /settle-tx returning 200) are all covered. Real tx submission is browser-side (Phantom) and intentionally excluded. If main agent changes server.py or vault builders, re-run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_quantumpos.py -v`.
